threads.body: [Naming] This collapses the established `ClassLoaders` word boundary into `Classloaders`, unlike `registerForAllClassLoaders` below and `HelperResource#allClassLoaders`. Rename the field and both references to `allClassLoadersResources` for consistent lower-camel naming.

replies.body:
Addressed in d6b44fe51955657232eaf2863555029ede50fc75.

Analysis: The field describes resources registered for all class loaders. Existing method and model names preserve `ClassLoaders` as two words, so `allClassLoadersResources` is the consistent lower-camel form.

Upsides: The field now matches nearby APIs and keeps the `ClassLoader` type name readable.

Downsides: No material downside identified
